topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Aye, neighbor, you can take a bit of my yard for your garden if you will. Times are hard, and the soil’s not as giving as it once was, but together, we might coax a little extra from the earth. I know the boundaries of my land, but I see no harm in blurring them a bit for a friend. The Lord would smile on such a thing, I reckon. Just mind the patch near the brook; the ground there is soft and the shade too thick for most seeds. We can share the wisdom of the seasons and maybe a meal from our labor, eh? The earth yields to the kind, or so I’ve found.
